name: tlive
description: Terminal live monitoring + IM bridge for AI coding tools

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run test:all && npm run build:all
scripts.build:src: npx esbuild src/cli/claude.ts src/cli/codex.ts src/cli/list.ts src/cli/stop.ts src/cli/logs.ts src/cli/resume.ts src/cli/mcp.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outdir=dist/src --out-extension:.js=.mjs --external:node-pty --external:ws --external:@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk --external:@modelcontextprotocol/sdk --entry-names=tlive-[name]
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:src
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:src
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p bridge/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.src.json
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test:all && npm run build:all
